notes.title: LightWave Available now for PC and macOS! Free downloadable demo! Release Notes
notes.content:
Be the first one to get your hands on the game, give feedback and shape development with an early bird discount this week only! 

You can download the demo from if you would like to see what the game is like before supporting development.

Releasing with the following summarized list of features:

[list]
[*] Five Grids (chapters) of levels to race through including a static tutorial.
[*] Singleplayer and multiplayer support of up to four players.
[*] Two different speedrun modes.
[*] Level dependant leaderboards and speedrun leaderboards.
[*] Configurable input system (beta)
[*] Beat the best times for copper and gold medals, and once you beat Grid 5, return to beat best times that will challenge your RGBeam skills.
[/list]


Some known issues:

[list]
[*] Video settings don't seem to work properly for every system, playing on smaller than 1920x1080 resolution may lead to strange scaling of UI (WIP)
[*] Very rare chance sliding under an obstacle can get you stuck. Sliding again will get you out. Does not happen everywhere.
[/list]
